Job Title: React Native Developer
Experience: 2-5 years
Location: Fully remote within India.

Mandatory Skills:
- React Native
- JavaScript

Good to have:
- Expo
- Firebase
- GraphQL

Responsibilities:
- Join a small, fast-moving product team at a growth-stage fintech startup building customer-facing mobile applications used by lakhs of users across India.
- Design, develop and maintain cross-platform mobile features using React Native and JavaScript, delivering performant, accessible, and maintainable code.
- Collaborate with product managers, designers and backend engineers to translate requirements and UI/UX designs into reliable mobile experiences.
- Implement modular, testable components, integrate with backend APIs, and ensure smooth state management and navigation flows.
- Own the end-to-end delivery of features from planning and estimation through development, code reviews, testing and deployment to app stores.
- Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and ship timely fixes and performance improvements.
- Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD pipelines for mobile builds, and maintain documentation and best practices for the mobile codebase.
- Mentor junior developers and participate in architecture discussions to shape the mobile roadmap.
